title: Term Life Insurance Billing Schedule: Grace Period, Shortage Tolerance and Overpayment Threshold
content:
For every Term Life Insurance tier the premium-accounting figures are the same.

| Figure | All six tiers (Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term; Ashgrove Level Term 10, 15, 20, 25, 30) |
|---|---|
| Grace period | 31 calendar days counted from the unpaid premium's due date |
| Grace period for policies issued in a listed state | California (CA): 60 calendar days, replacing the 31 days |
| Premium shortage tolerance | USD 2.00 — a payment short of the installment due by no more than this is accepted as full payment and the shortage stays billed |
| Overpayment refund threshold | USD 25.00 — unapplied money above this after a payment is refunded to the payer; at or below it is held toward the next installment |

**Points of reading.**

- The state override follows the issue state on the policy: a policy issued in California uses 60 days; a policy issued in any other state uses 31.
- Tolerance, hypothetical: on an installment of 100.00, a payment of 98.00 is short by exactly 2.00 and is within the tolerance; a payment of 97.99 is short by 2.01 and is not.
- Threshold, hypothetical: unapplied money of exactly 25.00 is held; 25.01 is refunded.
